training.algorithm: Constrained BC warm-start + PPO balanced safe policy improvement

physical_config.claim_boundary: V3.2候选先在2024-2025训练/验证段调优，再一次性打开2026年1-5月公开前向窗口。公开数据不含岸电表计、BMS、PCC结算或控制回执；任何候选均不得据此宣称上海港现场节省。

manifest.access_protocol_details: The complete historical 2024-2025 CSV bytes are loaded and quality-checked. August-December rows are never evaluated or used for gradients, scaling or selection. The separate 2026 forward file is never loaded.

training_episode_ledger.metrics_source: unaltered numeric environment info.episode_metrics from physical training rollouts
training_episode_ledger.claim_boundary: Physical training episode ledger, not validation or a post-optimizer checkpoint.

parameters.network_structure:
SACPolicy(
  (actor): Actor(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (latent_pi): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=31, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
    )
    (mu): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    (log_std): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
  )
  (critic): ContinuousCritic(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (qf0): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=32, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
    (qf1): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=32, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
  )
  (critic_target): ContinuousCritic(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (qf0): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=32, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
    (qf1): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=32, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
  )
)
parameters.sb3_update_counter_semantics: SB3 gradient iterations; actor/critic/entropy optimizer calls are counted separately
